adoption.rationale: The pinned config explicitly stores only the environment-variable name, and the receiver comment says the secret is resolved indirectly without logging the value. The identifier check precedes both indirect lookup and unset. Adoption covers only the accepted variable-name language and those two helper call sites.

contract.declared_domain: Exact Aidevops pin 8666b6c6c52472b5535aa295f2df593918152cb1; ASCII config strings usable as Bash variable names, unbounded length subject to the OS environment limit; contract covers both _resolve_secret at line 167 and _clear_webhook_secret_env at line 182, with line 167 as the indexed source site.
contract.guarantee: The receiver resolves and unsets a configured secret environment variable only when its name is a Bash identifier: an ASCII letter or underscore followed by zero or more ASCII letters, digits, or underscores. Invalid names are rejected before indirect parameter expansion or unset.
contract.input_source: Operator configuration from WEBHOOK_SECRET_ENV in the shell-sourceable webhook-receiver.conf or the documented environment override; this name selects which local environment variable holds the secret. The secret value itself is not the regex input.

domain: The configured secret-variable name accepted by the receiver is a Bash identifier
name: AE-aidevops-webhook-secret-env-identifier

adoption.rationale: The pinned docs describe exact-SHA invalidation, and the server emits a head SHA only after validating the webhook request. The receiver checks the exact 40-hex token before calling the cache invalidator; adoption is limited to that downstream argument invariant.

contract.declared_domain: Exact Aidevops pin 8666b6c6c52472b5535aa295f2df593918152cb1; ASCII strings in the authenticated local action protocol, with the intended SHA domain exactly 40 characters from 0-9, A-F, or a-f.
contract.guarantee: The receiver calls gh_pr_check_status_cache_invalidate only when the webhook-derived SHA token is exactly 40 ASCII hexadecimal characters and the repository slug also passes _webhook_valid_slug.
contract.input_source: The head SHA associated with a check, status, or workflow event in a GitHub webhook payload. The pinned Python server verifies the request signature and emits the validated value in the local action protocol; the shell helper validates it again before cache invalidation.

domain: The shell cache invalidator receives only a 40-character hexadecimal SHA token
name: AE-aidevops-webhook-check-sha-token

adoption.rationale: The server resolves event PR numbers as positive integers and serializes them into the local action protocol. The receiver rejects malformed action lines before calling process_pr. This adopts the final shell-side positive decimal token invariant and does not claim an attacker can inject arbitrary action-pipe data.

contract.declared_domain: Exact Aidevops pin 8666b6c6c52472b5535aa295f2df593918152cb1; canonical decimal strings produced by the pinned server from positive Python integers, delivered as a single action token. Property scope is the shell dispatcher condition at line 302 and its PROCESS_PR dispatch sink.
contract.guarantee: The receiver dispatches process_pr only when the PROCESS_PR action has exactly one positive decimal PR-number token after the repository slug and no extra fields; nondecimal text, zero, and negative values do not reach process_pr.
contract.input_source: Pull-request numbers resolved from GitHub webhook event fields by the pinned Python server, which accepts only positive integers and serializes them as decimal text in the local PROCESS_PR action. The shell receiver validates this protocol token before dispatch.

domain: Every nonempty token admitted by the receiver's Bash PR-number regex contains only decimal digits
name: AE-aidevops-webhook-process-pr-number
